Name: Replicoid
Description: When the Celestials were casting final judgement on the planet Pangonia the brave Asgardian warrior Thor sought to intervene and while his assault only cause the Celestials annoyance the formidable Exitar the Executioner saw the valor of the great warrior and produce a replica of him within minutes empowered it with the Celestial lifeforce. The replica came to Thor and restored his destroy hammer Mjolnir and teleported him out the planet not before telling Thor to no further intervene in his masters plans.
